objective: Decide whether public checkpoint diversity is sufficient for completion-stage pretraining before collecting matched model-switch outcomes.

frozen_recipe.model: TF-IDF terminal tail plus structured online features; logistic regression
frozen_recipe.threshold_selection: maximize source-weighted F1 on validation only

decision_rule: If every threshold passes, stop collecting generic successful stage data and move to matched multi-model and failed-run outcomes. If any threshold fails, diagnose that source or feature gap before paid routing collection.
